styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused north-facing daylight at 6500-7000K entering from a declared off-frame window side, wide gentle falloff, one long soft shadow under the seating only, no hard speculars and no hotspots; evening closing screen may add a single 2700K practical lamp while all other screens stay daylight-only; every piece sits on a visible contact shadow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte plaster wall, pale wide plank floor #DCD5CB with a visible skirting line, matte low-pile rug #E4E2DC, honed ceramic and matte painted metal accents; upholstery stays matte woven fabric exactly as supplied, never gloss or vinyl sheen
styleLock.typography: one light modern geometric sans-serif family only; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 26-32pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-12pt; generous top or left margin reserved for copy, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: 1.5px monoline pictograms plus small filled square number chips 01-06 in #6E8494 with #F4F2ED numerals, simple geometric shapes, maximum six per screen, no filled illustration, no 3D badges, no gradient seals
styleLock.presentationRules: the sofa keeps one proportional scale, the same arm profile, the same cushion count and the same slim leg form in every frame; it stands on the floor with a real contact shadow and never floats; interior verticals and floor lines stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (rug, console, coffee table or plant on a stand) always anchors human scale; the 3/4 daylight seating angle used on the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one room
noDrift: no recoloured or re-woven upholstery, no vinyl or leather look
no inconsistent lighting direction or contradictory shadow lengths
no mismatched icon or number-chip styles
no cozy yellowed lifestyle filter and no dark moody material grading
no invented dimensions, fabric grades, eco ratings, board specifications, warranty terms or certificates
no brand mark, no QR code, no membership or free-gift corner badge, no price

provenance.notes: 8 张详情页切片压缩为 11 镜，漏斗排序：成套场景首屏 → 白底合规主图 → 空房杂乱痛点 → 午后使用场景 → 织物缝线微距 → 细脚结构贴地仰视 → 素墙与线条背景墙对比 → 定制流程六步 → 织物配色与位数变体 → 三项清单与规格表 → 傍晚灯光收口。已剥离：源图全部中文营销字（品质选择/全屋定制 追求舒适生活/免费设计效果图/艺术选择北欧时尚/清单报价 透明消费/明码标价 拒绝赠项/配置齐全/个性定制/品质保障/专属服务 负责到底/案例展示 风格统一）与英文填充乱码 AUTHENTIC FLAVOR POWDER OF SNAILS，全部改写为 {selling_point_*}/{callout_*} 占位；末页『加入会员 全店免费』角标与二维码、店铺与公司自称、上门安装与专属服务承诺一律不入图；产品信息表的 型号/风格/适用空间/颜色/环保等级/房屋类型 六项保留为通用行名，数值一律置为占位符，未生成任何环保等级、板材级别与厚度、五金品牌、质保年限、每平米报价或认证。源图无人物出镜，本套同样禁止人物与手部，若后续复用出现设计师也必须是匿名且被裁切的局部。品类判定：本夹（全屋家装定制 2）实拍的唯一主体是反复出现在第 1、5、6、7、8 屏的浅灰织物低身直排沙发与它的客厅成套软装（护墙线条、挂画、地毯、绿植、圆几），全篇没有出现衣柜、橱柜或任何收纳柜体，故按图片主体取 L1 家具家纺、L2 客厅家具、leaf 北欧低身直排布艺沙发，不取 家装灯具/建材 也不套用 收纳家具。与库内已有套图差异化：家具家纺 内十套均为书柜/酒柜/衣柜/软包床/花瓶摆件，无布艺沙发；与 家装灯具/jiazhuangdengju-mianqi-mushimianban 的暗场炭灰 #1B1A18 加暖金 #B98A4E 衬线建筑感体系、以及 家具家纺/jiajujiafang-keyidong-jiafeng-shugui 的墨蓝 #2F4B57 加浅橡 #C8BCAD 单侧硬光长阴影体系完全不同——本模版锁定冷调 6500K 北向柔光、米白 #F4F2ED 与雾灰蓝 #6E8494 的轻盈客厅场、纯无衬线细字与方形编号芯片，主打客厅成套软装而非板材或柜体结构。源页所有垂直线（墙角、门套、护墙线条）与画框均按校正竖直处理，并以圆几、地毯与绿植作为真实家具尺度锚。
